commands.name: add_animator_layer
commands.description: Add a layer to an AnimatorController.

commands.name: add_animator_parameter
commands.description: Add a parameter (Float | Int | Bool | Trigger) to an AnimatorController. A duplicate name returns code 'duplicate_parameter'.

commands.name: add_animator_state
commands.description: Add a state to a layer, optionally with a motion (AnimationClip or BlendTree) and as the layer default. A layer name with no match returns code 'layer_not_found'.

commands.name: add_animator_transition
commands.description: Add a transition between two states (or from AnyState/Entry, to Exit) on a layer, with optional conditions. Validates that the states exist and each condition's parameter exists and its mode matches the parameter type.

commands.name: add_component
commands.description: Add a component (by type name) to a GameObject.

commands.name: add_scene_to_build
commands.description: Add a scene to the Build Settings scene list (idempotent). Optionally enable it.

commands.name: add_timeline_clip
commands.description: Add a clip to a named track on a TimelineAsset. For Animation tracks pass an AnimationClip asset; for Audio tracks an AudioClip. Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

commands.name: add_timeline_track
commands.description: Add a track (Animation | Audio | Activation | Control | Playable | Signal | Marker) to a TimelineAsset, optionally nested under a parent group/track. Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

commands.name: apply_prefab_overrides
commands.description: Apply a prefab instance's overrides back to its source prefab asset.

commands.name: attach_script
commands.description: Add a MonoBehaviour to a GameObject by its (compiled) type name OR by its script asset path. Provide exactly one of 'type' or 'script'. If the type isn't compiled yet, returns a recoverable error: recompile, poll recompile_status, then retry.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Run a Project Auditor static-analysis scan. Returns immediately; poll audit_status until status is 'completed', then read the CSV.

commands.name: audit_status
commands.description: Get the status of the last audit: idle | scanning | completed | failed | interrupted | unavailable.

commands.name: bake_lighting
commands.description: Trigger an async lightmap bake of the open scene(s) via Lightmapping.BakeAsync(). Returns immediately; poll lighting_bake_status until completed.

commands.name: bake_navmesh
commands.description: Trigger an async legacy NavMesh bake of the open scene(s) via UnityEditor.AI.NavMeshBuilder. Returns immediately; poll navmesh_bake_status until completed.

commands.name: bake_navmesh_surfaces
commands.description: Bake NavMeshSurface components (AI Navigation package). v1 stub: returns package_not_found when the package is absent.

commands.name: bake_occlusion_culling
commands.description: Trigger an async occlusion-culling bake of the open scene(s) via StaticOcclusionCulling.GenerateInBackground(). Returns immediately; poll occlusion_bake_status until completed.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Trigger an async Player build and report the full BuildReport. Returns immediately (queued); poll build_status until status is 'completed'. DetailedBuildReport is included by default unless 'options' is supplied. Use dry_run to validate without building.

commands.name: build_status
commands.description: Status of the current/most recent build: idle | queued | building | completed, with the full BuildReport (files, packedAssets, buildSteps, errors, warnings) once completed. Retained until the next build.

commands.name: cancel_lighting_bake
commands.description: Cancel an in-progress lighting bake (Lightmapping.Cancel()).

commands.name: cancel_navmesh_bake
commands.description: Cancel an in-progress NavMesh bake (NavMeshBuilder.Cancel()).

commands.name: cancel_occlusion_bake
commands.description: Cancel an in-progress occlusion bake (StaticOcclusionCulling.Cancel()).

commands.name: cancel_tests
commands.description: Cancel running test execution

commands.name: capture_game_view
commands.description: Render the game view to a PNG. source=camera (default) renders a camera and misses Screen Space - Overlay UI; source=screen captures the composited backbuffer incl. overlay canvases (Play Mode only). Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

commands.name: capture_scene_view
commands.description: Render the active Scene View to a PNG. Returns it inline as base64, unless save_path is set (path-only result; pass include_inline_image=true to get both).

commands.name: clear_baked_lighting
commands.description: Clear baked lightmap data for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

commands.name: clear_console
commands.description: Clear the captured log buffer and the Unity Editor console.

commands.name: clear_navmesh
commands.description: Clear the baked NavMesh for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

commands.name: clear_occlusion_culling
commands.description: Clear baked occlusion-culling data for the open scene(s). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

commands.name: console
commands.description: Get captured Unity console output (Editor or Player; supports tail, level filtering, and follow via a cursor)

commands.name: copy_asset
commands.description: Copy an asset to a new path under the authoring root. The copy gets a fresh GUID.

commands.name: create_animation_clip
commands.description: Create an empty .anim AnimationClip asset under the authoring root, with an optional frame rate and loop flag.

commands.name: create_animator_controller
commands.description: Create an .controller AnimatorController asset (with a default Base Layer) under the authoring root.

commands.name: create_asset
commands.description: Create a new ScriptableObject (or other UnityEngine.Object) asset of the given type at a path under the authoring root.

commands.name: create_folder
commands.description: Create a folder under the authoring root (creates intermediate folders).

commands.name: create_gameobject
commands.description: Create an empty GameObject or a built-in primitive (cube/sphere/capsule/cylinder/plane/quad) in the active scene.

commands.name: create_gameobjects
commands.description: Batch-create N empty GameObjects or primitives in one call. Optional positions/rotations/scales are arrays of [x,y,z] (length must equal count). Returns the created identities.

commands.name: create_prefab
commands.description: Save a GameObject as a prefab asset at a project path; the source becomes a connected instance.

commands.name: create_prefab_variant
commands.description: Create a prefab variant asset that inherits from a base prefab.

commands.name: create_scene
commands.description: Create a new scene and save it to the given path under the authoring root.

commands.name: create_script
commands.description: Create a new C# script (default base class MonoBehaviour) from a template under the authoring root. NOTE: the type does not exist until a recompile completes — to attach it, call recompile, poll recompile_status, then attach_script.

commands.name: create_timeline
commands.description: Create a .playable TimelineAsset under the authoring root (optional frame rate). Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

commands.name: delete_asset
commands.description: Delete an asset from the project. Destructive: requires confirm=true.

commands.name: delete_gameobject
commands.description: Delete a GameObject from the scene (reversible via Undo).

commands.name: editor_focus
commands.description: Bring the Unity Editor window to the foreground

commands.name: editor_pause
commands.description: Toggle pause state of Unity Editor play mode

commands.name: editor_play
commands.description: Enter Unity Editor play mode

commands.name: editor_status
commands.description: Get detailed Unity Editor status and state information

commands.name: editor_stop
commands.description: Exit Unity Editor play mode

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Evaluate C# code dynamically using Roslyn compiler

commands.name: eval_file
commands.description: Evaluate C# code read from a .cs file on disk

commands.name: find_assets
commands.description: Find assets by type and/or name and/or label, returning their path, GUID and type. At least one filter is required.

commands.name: find_gameobjects
commands.description: Find GameObjects in loaded scenes by name, tag, component type, and/or hierarchy path (filters are combined). Returns structured identities.

commands.name: get_animation_clip
commands.description: Read an AnimationClip's metadata and all float curve bindings (optionally with keyframes).

commands.name: get_animator_controller
commands.description: Read an AnimatorController's full structure: parameters, layers, states (with motion / default), and transitions (with conditions).

commands.name: get_audio_settings
commands.description: Read project Audio settings (volume, rolloff scale, doppler factor).

commands.name: get_authoring_root
commands.description: Get the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against.

commands.name: get_build_settings
commands.description: Read the current build configuration from EditorUserBuildSettings / EditorBuildSettings.

commands.name: get_component_properties
commands.description: Get a component's serialized properties as a JSON map. Address the component by handle, or by GameObject handle + type.

commands.name: get_console_logs
commands.description: Read recently captured Editor console logs (structured).

commands.name: get_graphics_settings
commands.description: Read GraphicsSettings (default render pipeline).

commands.name: get_import_settings
commands.description: Read an asset's import settings, structured by importer type (texture/model/audio), including the default-platform fields and (for textures/audio) one platform override block.

commands.name: get_input_settings
commands.description: Read the legacy Input Manager axes (names and count).

commands.name: get_lighting_settings
commands.description: Read the active LightingSettings (lightmapper, bounces, resolution, directional mode, AO, etc.).

commands.name: get_material_properties
commands.description: Read a material's shader, render queue, enabled keywords, and all shader properties with their current values (Color as [r,g,b,a], Vector as [x,y,z,w], Texture as an object reference).

commands.name: get_navmesh_settings
commands.description: Read the default agent's legacy NavMesh bake settings (agentRadius/Height/Slope/Climb, minRegionArea, voxelSize).

commands.name: get_performance_stats
commands.description: Read render, memory, and frame-timing stats (structured, read-only).

commands.name: get_physics_settings
commands.description: Read Physics settings (gravity, solver iterations, bounce threshold).

commands.name: get_player_settings
commands.description: Read PlayerSettings (company/product/version, scripting backend, API level).

commands.name: get_quality_settings
commands.description: Read QualitySettings (current level, level names, vSync, anti-aliasing).

commands.name: get_scene_hierarchy
commands.description: Return the GameObject tree of an open scene (or the active scene). Each node carries instanceId + hierarchyPath usable by GameObject commands.

commands.name: get_selection
commands.description: Read the current Editor selection as structured object identities.

commands.name: get_serialized_fields
commands.description: Read serialized fields of a component/asset. Returns each top-level field's name, type and value (object references are returned as re-usable handles). Pass 'field' to read a single SerializedProperty path.

commands.name: get_shader_properties
commands.description: Introspect a shader's declared property list (name, description, type Color|Vector|Float|Range|TexEnv|Int, range, textureDimension, flags). Provide 'shader' (by name) OR 'material' (read the shader off that material).

commands.name: get_tags_layers
commands.description: Read the project's tags and (named) layers.

commands.name: get_time_settings
commands.description: Read Time settings (fixedDeltaTime, maximumDeltaTime, timeScale).

commands.name: get_timeline
commands.description: Read a TimelineAsset's structure: frame rate, duration, and its tracks with their clips. Requires the com.unity.timeline package.

commands.name: import_asset
commands.description: Import an external file (e.g. a texture, model, audio clip) into the project by copying it to a path under the authoring root, then importing it.

commands.name: instantiate_prefab
commands.description: Instantiate a prefab asset into a loaded scene and return the created instance.

commands.name: lighting_bake_status
commands.description: Get the status of the last lighting bake: idle | baking | completed.

commands.name: list_build_profiles
commands.description: List Build Profile assets in the project (Unity 6 only). Returns feature_unavailable on earlier versions.

commands.name: list_build_targets
commands.description: List the known BuildTarget values with their group and whether build support is installed.

commands.name: list_open_scenes
commands.description: List all currently open scenes with their load/active/dirty state.

commands.name: list_shaders
commands.description: Discover available shaders so an agent can pick a valid name for set_material_properties / create_asset. Returns [{ name, assetPath|null, isBuiltin, isSupported }].

commands.name: list_tests
commands.description: List all available tests (EditMode and/or PlayMode) without running them

commands.name: menu
commands.description: Execute an Editor menu item by path, or list available items when no path is given

commands.name: move_asset
commands.description: Move (or rename via a new path) an asset to a new location under the authoring root. Preserves the asset's GUID.

commands.name: navmesh_bake_status
commands.description: Get the status of the last NavMesh bake: idle | baking | completed.

commands.name: occlusion_bake_status
commands.description: Get the status of the last occlusion bake: idle | baking | completed.

commands.name: open_scene
commands.description: Open an existing scene from the given path.

commands.name: package_add
commands.description: Add a UPM package by name@version, git URL, or 'file:' local path. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package_status); pass wait=true to block until added. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

commands.name: package_list
commands.description: List packages by scope: installed (default) | available (registry) | all (both). Returns the full result synchronously — available/all block until the registry query completes.

commands.name: package_remove
commands.description: Remove a UPM package by name. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package_status); pass wait=true to block until removed. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

commands.name: package_resolve
commands.description: Resolve/refresh packages from the manifest (re-fetch and re-link). May trigger a recompile/domain reload — poll recompile_status. Its outcome is recorded for package_status.

commands.name: package_search
commands.description: Search packages available in the registry. Provide a name (e.g. com.unity.foo) or omit to list all. Returns the full result synchronously (blocks until the registry query completes).

commands.name: package_status
commands.description: Status of the last async package operation (add/remove/resolve): idle | in_progress | completed | failed, with the added package, manifest, and any error.

commands.name: read_text_file
commands.description: Read a UTF-8 text file under the authoring root and return its contents.

commands.name: recompile
commands.description: Force a script recompile (works while unfocused/minimized). Poll recompile_status for completion.

commands.name: recompile_status
commands.description: Get the status of the last recompile: idle | triggered | compiling | completed | up_to_date.

commands.name: reload_file
commands.description: Compile and apply in-place [HotReload] edits from a source file

commands.name: reload_file_override
commands.description: Compile and apply hot reload file changes immediately

commands.name: remove_animation_curve
commands.description: Remove a float curve binding from an AnimationClip (SetEditorCurve(clip, binding, null)). Destructive: requires confirm=true.

commands.name: remove_component
commands.description: Remove a component from a GameObject. Provide either a component handle (target) or a GameObject handle (target) plus a type name.

commands.name: remove_scene_from_build
commands.description: Remove a scene from the Build Settings scene list (idempotent).

commands.name: rename_asset
commands.description: Rename an asset in place (keeps it in the same folder, keeps its GUID).

commands.name: rename_gameobject
commands.description: Rename a GameObject.

commands.name: revert_prefab_overrides
commands.description: Revert a prefab instance's overrides so it matches its source prefab asset.

commands.name: run_tests
commands.description: Execute Unity tests with filtering options

commands.name: save_all
commands.description: Save all open scenes that have unsaved changes.

commands.name: save_prefab_contents
commands.description: Open a prefab asset in an isolated prefab stage, apply a declarative edit, and save it back (nested-prefab safe).

commands.name: save_scene
commands.description: Save an open scene. Saves the active scene when no path is given.

commands.name: screenshot
commands.description: Capture the Scene or Game view as a PNG and return its file path

commands.name: search
commands.description: Run a Unity Search query and return structured results.

commands.name: set_active
commands.description: Set a GameObject's active self-state (activeSelf).

commands.name: set_active_scene
commands.description: Set which open scene is the active scene (new objects are created in the active scene).

commands.name: set_animation_curve
commands.description: Add or replace a single float curve binding on an AnimationClip (via AnimationUtility.SetEditorCurve). Replacing an existing binding overwrites it rather than duplicating.

commands.name: set_audio_settings
commands.description: Change project Audio settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

commands.name: set_authoring_root
commands.description: Set the base folder (under Assets/) that bare authoring paths resolve against and are confined to. Use 'Assets' for full project access.

commands.name: set_autotick
commands.description: Keep the editor ticking while unfocused by forcing EditorApplication.SignalTick at a throttled rate

commands.name: set_build_settings
commands.description: Set mutable EditorUserBuildSettings fields. Does NOT manage scenes (use add_scene_to_build / remove_scene_from_build) or switch target (use switch_build_target). Use dry_run to preview.

commands.name: set_component_properties
commands.description: Set serialized properties on a component (one Undo step). 'properties' maps property name -> value; object references accept an ObjectRef handle.

commands.name: set_graphics_settings
commands.description: Set the default render pipeline asset. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

commands.name: set_import_settings
commands.description: Set import settings on an asset's AssetImporter (default platform top-level properties, or a texture/audio per-platform override) and re-import it.

commands.name: set_input_settings
commands.description: Tune a legacy Input Manager axis (sensitivity/gravity/dead) by name. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

commands.name: set_layer
commands.description: Set a GameObject's layer by name or numeric index (0-31).

commands.name: set_lighting_settings
commands.description: Apply a subset of lighting settings to the active LightingSettings. Returns { applied[], unknown[] }.

commands.name: set_material_properties
commands.description: Set shader properties on a material (Float/Range/Int=number; Color=[r,g,b,a] or "#RRGGBBAA" hex; Vector=[x,y,z,w]; Texture=an object reference or null to clear), optionally reassign the shader, set the render queue, and toggle keywords. Unknown names / type mismatches are reported in unknown[].

commands.name: set_navmesh_settings
commands.description: Apply a subset of legacy NavMesh bake settings to the default agent. Returns { applied[], unknown[] }.

commands.name: set_parent
commands.description: Reparent a GameObject under a new parent, or detach it to scene root when no parent is given.

commands.name: set_physics_settings
commands.description: Change Physics settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

commands.name: set_player_settings
commands.description: Change PlayerSettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z. Scripting backend / API level changes trigger a domain reload.

commands.name: set_quality_settings
commands.description: Change QualitySettings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

commands.name: set_selection
commands.description: Set the Editor selection to the given assets/scene objects.

commands.name: set_serialized_field
commands.description: Set a serialized field on a component/asset. Supports primitives, enums, Vector/Color/Rect/Bounds, object references (value = an ObjectRef: asset by guid/fileId/path or scene object by instanceId/hierarchyPath), and array elements via 'name.Array.data[i]' (or 'name.Array.size' to resize).

commands.name: set_tag
commands.description: Set a GameObject's tag (the tag must already exist in the project).

commands.name: set_tags_layers
commands.description: Add/remove tags and assign user layer names (index 8-31). Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

commands.name: set_time_settings
commands.description: Change Time settings. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview. Not undoable via Ctrl+Z.

commands.name: set_transform
commands.description: Set a GameObject's local position/rotation(euler)/scale. Omitted channels are left unchanged.

commands.name: switch_build_target
commands.description: Switch the active build target (destructive, long-running: triggers a full reimport + domain reload). Requires confirm=true. Returns immediately; poll switch_build_target_status.

commands.name: switch_build_target_status
commands.description: Status of the last target switch: idle | switching | completed (with success + activeBuildTarget).

commands.name: test_status
commands.description: Get status of running async test execution

commands.name: unpack_prefab
commands.description: Unpack a prefab instance into plain GameObjects (outermost level or completely).

commands.name: write_text_file
commands.description: Write UTF-8 text to a file under the authoring root, then import it. Overwriting an existing file requires confirm=true.
